youtube.title: Abraham Lincoln got challenged to a duel. He picked SWORDS ⚔️ #shorts
youtube.caption:
Abraham Lincoln almost fought a real duel in 1842 ⚔️

Would you show up to this duel? Comment the reply YOU would've sent 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: James Shields challenged Lincoln over anonymous letters mocking him. Lincoln, 6'4" with long arms, chose cavalry broadswords. On the dueling ground he reportedly cut a branch high above Shields' head, and the duel was called off. In 1861 Lincoln made Shields a Union general.
